about.title: About
about.description: I help cafes, restaurants, bakeries, salons, and small businesses in Bolzano create mobile-friendly websites, online menus, booking flows, and simple admin tools that make it easier for customers to contact, order, or reserve.

steps.title: Discovery Call
steps.description: We hop on a quick call to understand your business, your customers, and what you need.

steps.title: Proposal & Design
steps.description: I put together a tailored proposal with wireframes and a clear timeline.

steps.title: Build & Review
steps.description: I build your site or tool while keeping you in the loop every step of the way.

steps.title: Launch & Support
steps.description: We go live, and I stay around to help with updates, changes, and questions.

reasons.title: Mobile-First Design
reasons.description: Every site I build looks and works beautifully on phones first — because that is where your customers are.

reasons.title: WhatsApp-Friendly
reasons.description: Integrated WhatsApp messaging so customers can reach you instantly — the way people actually communicate today.

reasons.title: Simple Admin Tools
reasons.description: You get an easy-to-use dashboard to update menus, view orders, and manage bookings — no tech experience needed.

reasons.title: Local Bolzano Focus
reasons.description: I am based in Bolzano and understand the local market. German, Italian, and English — I speak your customers' language.

reasons.title: Clean & Professional
reasons.description: No clutter, no fluff. Every design is purposeful, accessible, and built to make your business look its best.

reasons.title: Support After Launch
reasons.description: I do not disappear after launch. You get ongoing support, updates, and someone who actually picks up when you call.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: Real projects I have built. Each one is designed to solve a real problem for a local business.

projects.title: Bakery Ordering Website
projects.description: A complete online presence for a local bakery with a digital menu, order-ahead functionality, and WhatsApp order notifications.

projects.title: Restaurant / Cafe Ordering Demo
projects.description: A QR-code-based ordering system for restaurants and cafes. Customers scan, browse, and order from their phones.
features: QR code menu at every table

projects.title: Salon Booking Demo
projects.description: An online booking system for salons and beauty studios. Clients book appointments, pick services, and get reminders.

services.title: Services
services.description: Everything a local business needs to thrive online — from a simple website to a complete ordering and booking system.

items.title: Business Websites
items.description: Mobile-friendly, fast-loading websites tailored to your business. A clean online presence that helps customers find you and get in touch.

items.title: Online Ordering Tools
items.description: Let customers browse your menu and place orders directly from their phones. Simple to manage, easy for your customers to use.

items.title: Booking & Reservation Systems
items.description: Accept reservations and appointment bookings online. Customers pick a time, you get notified, and availability updates automatically.

items.title: QR Menus
items.description: Replace paper menus with scannable QR codes that link to your digital menu. Customers view it on their phone — no app, no hassle.

items.title: Admin Dashboards
items.description: A private panel where you manage orders, update your menu, view bookings, and track customer activity. No technical skills required.

items.title: Monthly Maintenance
items.description: Ongoing support to keep your site updated, secure, and running smoothly. Content updates, performance checks, and peace of mind.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Let's talk about what your business needs. A quick call or a few messages is all it takes to get started.
